en: A tinted vintage view over a riverside or coastal town, seen from an elevated position. In the foreground are tightly packed wooden and stone buildings with steep metal roofs, chimneys, and tree-lined streets. To the right is a long rectangular waterfront building with an arcade-like facade. The middle ground shows several small piers and boats along a curving shoreline. Across a wide expanse of calm water lies a low, sparsely built strip of land, with more water and low hills in the hazy distance. The sky is lightly colored blue with a few clouds. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
